LESSON: BRACELETS

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: ORNAMENTS
Topic 7.2: Bracelets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Bracelets. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. make and decorate bracelets for friendship.
2. making bracelets for enjoyment bracelets using techniques of their choice make the bracelets. Core-Competence

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. make and decorate bracelets for friendship.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to make and decorate bracelets for friendship. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. making bracelets for enjoyment bracelets using techniques of their choice make the bracelets. Core-Competence
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to making bracelets for enjoyment bracelets using techniques of their choice make the bracelets. Core-Competence. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Bracelets.
2. Explain Bracelets to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to identify 1. What are the beads learner should be able to; locally available materials strung on? 4 lessons a) identify local materials for for making bracelets. 2. What do you use to making bracelets
4. Show that you can: make and decorate bracelets for friendship.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Bracelets. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Bracelets important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners to identify 1. What are the beads learner should be able to; locally available materials strung on? 4 lessons a) identify local materials for for making bracelets. 2. What do you use to making bracelets
2. Be guided to strung the beads b) make and decorate bracelets for observe a video on 3. How do we make friendship. decoration of bracelets bracelets beautiful? c) making bracelets for enjoyment
3. Guide learners to decorate bracelets using techniques of their choice
4. Observation; the students can demonstrate that they have in fact learned the skill of using their fine motor skills by demonstrating to the teacher.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. make and decorate bracelets for friendship.
2. making bracelets for enjoyment bracelets using techniques of their choice make the bracelets. Core-Competence
